items.author: manaflare-mtg.bsky.social
items.context:
Not my typical game - but Librarian was a really zen 4-5 hours on my #steamdeck. Who knew that shelving ~3500 books could be such a good time? The game loop is rewarding: find book, find shelf, put book on shelf. And as you go you get abilities that allow to to become faster and more efficient.
image, no description
items.text: Shelving books as a zen game loop sounds like a perfect fit for short Deck sessions. Glad it hit the spot.

items.author: audrey-voltaire.bsky.social
items.context: Does anyone have any good suggestions for visual novel games that are good? Trying to start a list to go through. So far I got Veins like Tapeworms, nearly a year ago I was introduced to it and been meaning to pick it up.
items.text: Coffee Talk and VA-11 Hall-A are both well-loved visual novels on PC. Coffee Talk is the calmer of the two.
